\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সিটবেল্ট} (siṭbelṭ)}{সিটবেল্ট (siṭbelṭ)}]{\bn{সিটবেল্ট} (siṭbelṭ) — a seat belt}

\label{lesson:BN-C535-sitbelt}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for auspicious, then the Bengali for to come true.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সিটবেল্ট}}
\textbf{\bn{সিটবেল্ট}} — \emph{siṭbelṭ} — \textquotedblleft{}a seat belt\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{গাড়িতে} \bn{উঠে} \bn{আমি} \bn{সিটবেল্ট} \bn{বাঁধলাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Gāṛite uṭhe āmi siṭbelṭ bā̃dhlām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I got into the car and fastened my seat belt.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সিটবেল্ট}} (\emph{siṭbelṭ}) is borrowed from English \emph{seat belt}, written as one word.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{siṭbelṭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{siṭbelṭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Gāṛite uṭhe āmi siṭbelṭ bā̃dhlām.} — I got into the car and fastened my seat belt.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for auspicious, then the Bengali for to come true, then say \emph{siṭbelṭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সিটবেল্ট} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A seat belt\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিমা} (bimā)}{বিমা (bimā)}]{\bn{বিমা} (bimā) — insurance}

\label{lesson:BN-C535-bima}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to come true, then the Bengali for a seat belt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিমা}}
\textbf{\bn{বিমা}} — \emph{bimā} — \textquotedblleft{}insurance\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{গাড়ির} \bn{বিমা} \bn{থাকলে} \bn{দুর্ঘটনার} \bn{পরে} \bn{কোম্পানি} \bn{খরচ} \bn{দেবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Gāṛir bimā thākle durghôṭônār pôre kompāni khôrôch debe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the car is insured, the company will pay the costs after an accident.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিমা}} (\emph{bimā}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{bīma}, built on \emph{bīm}, \textquotedblleft{}fear\textquotedblright{}: cover against what you fear.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bimā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bimā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Gāṛir bimā thākle durghôṭônār pôre kompāni khôrôch debe.} — If the car is insured, the company will pay the costs after an accident.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to come true, then the Bengali for a seat belt, then say \emph{bimā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বিমা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Insurance\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{গ্যারান্টি} (gærānṭi)}{গ্যারান্টি (gærānṭi)}]{\bn{গ্যারান্টি} (gærānṭi) — a guarantee}

\label{lesson:BN-C535-geranti}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a seat belt, then the Bengali for insurance.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{গ্যারান্টি}}
\textbf{\bn{গ্যারান্টি}} — \emph{gærānṭi} — \textquotedblleft{}a guarantee\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{ঘড়ির} \bn{দুই} \bn{বছরের} \bn{গ্যারান্টি} \bn{আছে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ei ghôṛir dui bôchhôrer gærānṭi āchhe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This watch has a two-year guarantee.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{গ্যারান্টি}} (\emph{gærānṭi}) is borrowed from English \emph{guarantee}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gærānṭi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{gærānṭi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ei ghôṛir dui bôchhôrer gærānṭi āchhe.} — This watch has a two-year guarantee.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a seat belt, then the Bengali for insurance, then say \emph{gærānṭi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{গ্যারান্টি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A guarantee\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সুরক্ষিত} (surôkkhit)}{সুরক্ষিত (surôkkhit)}]{\bn{সুরক্ষিত} (surôkkhit) — well protected; safe}

\label{lesson:BN-C535-surokkhit}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for insurance, then the Bengali for a guarantee.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সুরক্ষিত}}
\textbf{\bn{সুরক্ষিত}} — \emph{surôkkhit} — \textquotedblleft{}well protected; safe\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{টাকা} \bn{ব্যাংকে} \bn{সুরক্ষিত।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmāder ṭākā bængke surôkkhit.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our money is safe in the bank.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সুরক্ষিত}} (\emph{surôkkhit}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{surakṣita}, \textquotedblleft{}well protected, carefully guarded\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{surôkkhit}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{surôkkhit}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmāder ṭākā bængke surôkkhit.} — Our money is safe in the bank.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for insurance, then the Bengali for a guarantee, then say \emph{surôkkhit} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সুরক্ষিত} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Well protected; safe\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক} (ôgninirbāpôk)}{অগ্নিনির্বাপক (ôgninirbāpôk)}]{\bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক} (ôgninirbāpôk) — a fire extinguisher}

\label{lesson:BN-C535-ogninirbapok}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a guarantee, then the Bengali for well protected.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক}}
\textbf{\bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক}} — \emph{ôgninirbāpôk} — \textquotedblleft{}a fire extinguisher\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আগুন} \bn{লাগলে} \bn{আমরা} \bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক} \bn{দিয়ে} \bn{আগুন} \bn{নেভাব।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āgun lāgle āmrā ôgninirbāpôk diye āgun nebhābô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If a fire breaks out, we'll put it out with the extinguisher.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক}} (\emph{ôgninirbāpôk}) joins Sanskrit \emph{agni}, \textquotedblleft{}fire\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{nirvāpaka}, \textquotedblleft{}putting out\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôgninirbāpôk}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ôgninirbāpôk}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āgun lāgle āmrā ôgninirbāpôk diye āgun nebhābô.} — If a fire breaks out, we'll put it out with the extinguisher.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a guarantee, then the Bengali for well protected, then say \emph{ôgninirbāpôk} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{অগ্নিনির্বাপক} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A fire extinguisher\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
